notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Basking Broodscale has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Pentad Prism has at least one charge counter on it.
description:
Activate Blade of Shared Souls' equip ability by paying {2}, attaching it to another creature you control.
Blade of Shared Souls triggers, causing the creature it is attached to to become a copy of Roalesk.
Put the creature with Blade of Shared Souls attached into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The creature triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Basking Broodscale and two charge counters on Pentad Prism.
Basking Broodscale triggers twice, creating two 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
Activate Pentad Prism twice by removing two charge counters from it, adding {2}.
Repeat.
Alternatively, you may only remove one counter from Pentad Prism and sacrifice an Eldrazi Spawn instead.
